thread:
nora: deploy-bot just flagged a canary p95 regression (~+30%) on /generate during the v3.0 rollout (us-west). It suggests auto-revert. Need a quick decision.
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +30% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold breached. Suggested action: trigger-auto-rollback. [telemetry link]
tess: Oncall for the window. Are 5xxs or customer errors increasing or is this latency-only?
nora: No 5xxs, no CS tickets. Throughput dipped and tail latency went up. Observed spike in KV cache misses and large batching queues after the new runtime enabled continuous batching.
frank: Interesting — could be head-of-line with bigger batches + some kernel path. Rather than full revert, can we temporarily turn batching back to legacy mode or reduce max_batch_tokens? That has lower blast than a full binary revert.
release-bot: POLICY: Runtime config toggles during change windows require release-owner + oncall approval. Manual intervention will suppress auto-revert. Please acknowledge.
tess: I approve trying a runtime config rollback (batching -> legacy) as the mitigation. Nora, you own rollout notes. Frank, can you flip the flag and monitor for 5m?
frank: Running command: ```rwctl feature flip --name=runtime.batch_mode --to=legacy --env=us-west --reason="canary p95 spike"```
frank: Applied change; new config propagating to serving fleet (~60s). Monitoring p95, kvcache-miss, and queue depth.
deploy-bot: ACTION: runtime config change detected: runtime.batch_mode=legacy. Auto-revert suppressed while manual mitigation active.
frank: Telemetry: p95 dropped ~24% within 70s, queue depth reduced, kvcache misses declined. Throughput back to expected levels.
tess: Good signal. Hold rollout paused for investigation. If stability holds for 10m, we suppress auto-revert and proceed with a gated re-run after RCA.
release-bot: LOG: runtime config rollback executed by frank; approved by tess. Action recorded.
ops-bot: NOTE: Because this change impacts serving behavior, open a follow-up RCA ticket and add the config flip to the release notes.
nora: Drafting blurb: "During a staged rollout we observed increased tail latency correlated with continuous batching enabled in the new runtime. We temporarily reverted the batching config to the previous legacy mode for us-west while we investigate. No user-facing errors were reported. Rollout paused pending RCA"
frank: Add next steps: reproduce with same kernel flags in staging, run perf sweep with varied batch sizes, and capture KVcache profiles.
nora: Added. Posting to #release-notes and notifying CS. Closing unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup: closing from oncall.
deploy-bot: INCIDENT-STATE: mitigated; auto-revert suppressed."
